question: FIFA World Cup is associated with ________ sport.
solution:
The correct answer is Football.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **FIFA World Cup:-**

 
 
• **The FIFA World Cup is an international association football competition between the senior men's national teams of the members of the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA), the sport's global governing body. **
 
• The tournament has been held every four years since the inaugural tournament in 1930, with the exception of 1942 and 1946 due to the Second World War.
 
• The reigning champions are Argentina, who won their third title at the 2022 tournament. 
 
• The World Cup has been won by eight different teams, with Brazil having the most titles with five. Other successful teams include Germany and Italy with four titles each, Argentina and Uruguay with three titles each, and France and England with one title each.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA):

 
 
• Headquarters: Zurich, Switzerland.
 
• President: Gianni Infantino.
 
• Secretary-General: Fatma Samba Diouf Samoura
 
• Founded: 21 May 1904​
